incident.summary: The 0.8.2 repair incorrectly treated parent continuity and child business-state correlation as shared identity, adding a UAOS-aware validator to the Financial business package and requiring UAOS and Financial task IDs to be equal.

root_cause: Cross-repository continuity was modeled as identity unification instead of delegation plus opaque reference. A redundant TaskContract.task_id inside Financial also obscured the actual domain aggregate identity already carried by STATE.task_id, receipts and workspace paths.

changes: remove financial_writing_agent.uaos_binding and its equality tests
keep UAOS semantics in .uaos adapter metadata instead of Financial business package
declare parent and Financial identity namespaces distinct
make Financial STATE.task_id the sole article identity authority
remove duplicate identity from TaskContract so it is an identity-free business/output value object
retain the existing ten-stage writing workflow, business rules, historical article states and artifacts unchanged

acceptance: all existing Financial unit and trajectory tests pass
STATE.task_id remains immutable through Financial transitions and binds receipts/artifact paths
parent-specific task-ID equality logic is absent from financial_writing_agent package
isolated wheel smoke proves no uaos_binding module and identity-free TaskContract
